subject: AcmeCloud procurement readiness & next steps (post-demo)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Harris <tharris@acmecloud.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Darren Cole <darren.cole@acmecloud.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: AcmeCloud procurement readiness & next steps (post-demo)

Hi Tom / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time to walk through the demo today. Great questions from your team — I wanted to capture the key next steps and a suggested timeline so procurement and finance can plan: 

Summary of decisions from call:
- Technical fit confirmed for our Dedicated offering (GPU pools) for initial pilot.
- Primary commercial path: prefer PO-based invoicing via Accounts Payable, but team asked whether card payment could be used for the initial POC.
- Marketplace interest: you asked if Redwood is listed on CloudMarket (we are) and whether you can subscribe there to streamline procurement.

Suggested mutual action plan (attached: Redwood-MAP-v1.xlsx):
1) Legal review (SOW + standard MSA): 1-2 weeks to review redlines (Laura on our side and your legal).
2) Security review (SOC 2 questionnaire + evidence): ~1 week if standard questions only; longer if custom evidence requested.
3) Finance review & PO issuance: once terms agreed, Acme to issue PO; typical internal PO lead time you described is 1-2 weeks depending on approvals.
4) Kickoff / provisioning: 3-5 business days after PO.

Questions for your procurement/finance team to confirm: 
- Would you prefer to procure via PO (net-30) for pilot, or do you want to start on card for speed?
- If PO, who is the billing contact and which legal template should we send (standard MSA or SOW-first)?
- Any required procurement forms (W-9, vendor onboarding) we should provide up front?

I'll loop in our legal and finance points of contact once you confirm the preferred path.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm internal PO vs card preference by EOD Monday 3/16.
- If PO: we share SOW + pricing quote and Laura (legal) will be on the thread for redlines.
- If card: we can provision a trial account within 24 hours and follow up on contract formalities in parallel.

Thanks — attaching a draft MAP and a simple SOW template to speed review.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-MAP-v1.xlsx, SOW-draft-acmecloud.docx
From: Tom Harris <tharris@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmecloud.com>, Darren Cole <darren.cole@acmecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AcmeCloud procurement readiness & next steps (post-demo)

Thanks Marissa — useful summary. Quick answers from procurement: 

- We'd prefer to start the POC on card for speed (Procurement is OK with short-term card payments), but the pilot budget will need to convert to a PO if we expand past the POC.
- Billing contact for PO process (if/when needed): Marcus Lin (marcus.lin@acmecloud.com).
- We are interested in Marketplace purchase to simplify future renewals — can you confirm Redwood listing and whether pricing differs if bought through CloudMarket?

I'll loop Marcus in once I confirm internally on the card vs PO thresholds. Can you also confirm whether Redwood requires a signed MSA before we issue a PO or if an SOW + PO is sufficient for pilot?

Thanks,
Tom
VP, Product & Partnerships | AcmeCloud
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Harris <tharris@acmecloud.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AcmeCloud procurement readiness & next steps (post-demo)

Tom — thanks for the quick response and for looping Marcus in. Quick answers:

- Marketplace: yes, Redwood is listed on CloudMarket. Pricing is identical for the SKU we recommended; marketplace purchases provide simplified billing/renewal on their side but can add 5-7 business days for vendor onboarding on the marketplace side.
- Contract requirement: for a pilot/PO we can accept SOW + PO as sufficient. For longer-term commitments we typically request an MSA; Laura is cc'd to confirm any exceptions.

Laura — could you confirm the standard approach here (SOW-first vs MSA) and whether we need to attach any additional exhibit for security?

Marcus — do you have the PO owner and an expected lead time if the pilot converts to PO? Also cc: any AP contact who will process vendor onboarding forms (W-9 etc.).

I'll schedule a 15-min procurement sync if helpful.

Best,
Marissa
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Tom Harris <tharris@acmecloud.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@acmecloud.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AcmeCloud procurement readiness & next steps (post-demo)

Hi all —

Confirming Redwood's standard flow: for a short pilot we are fine with SOW + PO. We will surface the standard MSA language if Acme wants a longer-term agreement. 

Security exhibits: we typically provide a SOC 2 report and a short security exhibit for data handling controls. If Acme's security team requests an additional questionnaire or evidence, that can add 3-7 business days depending on the scope.

I've reviewed the attached SOW draft and added a couple of minor cleanups — attaching comments in the docx. If we see any non-standard redlines from Acme legal, let's capture them in a single consolidated redline set to keep cycles short.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Tom Harris <tharris@acmecloud.com>

Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AcmeCloud procurement readiness & next steps (post-demo)

Hi Marissa — looping in AP contact (Priya) here. Quick notes from finance: 

- For the pilot we will pay by card to avoid delays; if the pilot expands we expect to issue a PO within 10 business days of signed SOW.
- AP contact: Priya Shah (priya.shah@acmecloud.com). She handles vendor onboarding and PO issuance.
- Required vendor docs: W-9, vendor setup form (I attached the form link internally). Please send W-9 and any vendor questionnaire to Priya.

Tom — we'll aim to confirm final path (card for pilot + PO on conversion) by EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Marcus
Director, Finance | AcmeCloud
